scope: Human ophthalmology, ocular biometrics, and direct translational ocular resources; animal records are retained only for explicit ophthalmic modality, disease mechanism, imaging method, or surgical-method utility.
quantity_rule: Each retained row has either a source-stated numeric primary quantity or a named file-level research object; file count is not used as a scientific quantity.

normalized_vocabularies.primary_categories: Existing catalog primary_category values where a direct mapping was available.
normalized_vocabularies.tasks: Existing catalog task vocabulary values where a direct mapping was available.
